messages:
amelia: heads up: scheduling v2 switchboard rollout in eu-west tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. need prober pinlist and mobile sdk signoff. who can watch the canary?
raj: i'm on call, happy to take it. can you include deploybot timeline + affected tenants?
amelia: scheduling region eu-west, excludes prod-legacy tenants. window 02:00-03:00. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. fallback: pin prober-only to v1 for 30m if probes fail.
patrick: mobile SDK team: SDK 1.4.2 has the compatibility header sniff. we can accept a 1h pin if needed.
ops-jen: runbooks updated, release-notes PR linked: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/421
deploy-bot: /schedule rollout v2 --region eu-west --window 2025-04-01T02:00Z/2025-04-01T03:00Z --canary 5% --probe prober-switch
deploy-bot: job 8934 scheduled by amelia 1: canary steps 5%->25%->100% over 30m
sre-liz: alert thresholds: canary error >1.5% or p95 latency >1200ms -> pause + auto-pin. token-level tracing enabled (100% sample).
marco: pushed a prober header-negotiation smoke test to smoke/ci: ci/infra#217
raj: pulling telemetry dashboards, need per-tenant token breakdown ready.
ops-jen: excerpt from runbook: if canary fails run `deploy-bot rollback 8934` then pin routes: `api.pin header=Client-Version v1`
mobile-team: acknowledged. we'll monitor crashlytics and SDK telemetry during window.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 5% -> 25% (after 12m) -> 45% (after 18m). metrics look nominal so far.
sre-liz: small error spike on shard s-11, tenant t-342 showing model-timeout. requesting logs.
raj: grabbing logs now:
```
2025-04-01T02:17:58Z GET /v2 500 tenant=t-342 upstream: model-timeout
2025-04-01T02:17:59Z GET /v2 500 tenant=t-342 upstream: kv-cache-miss
```
sre-liz: correlation shows model-timeout on that partition. recomend pinning tenant t-342 back to v1 and pausing roll.
amelia: approve pin and pause. ops-jen can you execute?
ops-jen: running: `deploy-bot pin tenant t-342 --target v1 --reason "canary model-timeout" --ttl 1h`
deploy-bot: tenant t-342 pinned to v1 (ttl=1h). roll job 8934 status: PAUSED.
patrick: adding to release notes: "Transient model timeouts observed for tenant t-342; tenant pinned to v1 during investigation."
sre-liz: created PM stub and assigned to runtime-team; assigning alert to @raj.
raj: collecting kernel/hw metrics and grabbing model logs. will post findings in #eng-runtime shortly.
amelia: we'll reassess at 02:45 UTC for resume vs full rollback. thanks all :thumbsup:
